ops.rationale: The author names of the entry differ from the Crossref record of its DOI, which gives Hong He, Yonghong Tan and Jianfeng Xing with the same title, year, volume and pages.
The first author is H. Brendan McMahan in the arXiv record and in the text of the paper; the entry drops the initial H.

The doi field holds an escaped underscore, so the DOI link answers 404; Crossref, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar resolve the bare DOI 10.1007/978-3-642-37456-2_14 to this chapter, and the bibliography style prints the field verbatim.
